twin.label: TWIN
twin.does: The power acts twice, a beat apart.

wide.label: WIDE
wide.does: Half again the reach and the size.

echo.label: ECHO
echo.does: The act comes again where it ended, three real seconds on.

thrift.label: THRIFT
thrift.does: Matter made from nothing costs half.

linger.label: LINGER
linger.does: Portals, wards, totems and the rest stand twice as long.

gentle.label: GENTLE
gentle.does: No harm to creatures: a blow becomes a push.
